chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from 'Amr ibn 'Uthman al-Kazzaz, from Ali ibn 'Abdullah al-Bajali, from Khalid al-Qalanisi, from Abu 'Abdullah (peace be upon him), who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) said: 'Perform Hajj and perform 'Umrah, your bodies will be cured, your livelihoods will be expanded, and you will be provided for the needs of your dependents.'
And he (peace be upon him) said: 'For the pilgrim, forgiveness is granted, Paradise is obligated for him, his deeds are renewed, and he is protected regarding his family and his wealth.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual and worldly rewards of performing Hajj and Umrah according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS), the virtues of Hajj and 'Umrah are presented as holistic remedies for both the body and the soul, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the integration of spiritual devotion with worldly well-being. The text underscores the concept of 'Jabran' (compensation/renewal) for deeds and the preservation of the pilgrim's household, a theme deeply rooted in the theological understanding of pilgrimage as a means of spiritual purification and divine favor.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Amro Bin Usman Al Hazaz, from Ali Bin Abdullah Al Bajaly, from Khalid Al Qalanasy, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Perform Hajj and perform Umra, it would correct your bodies, and expand your livelihoods, and there would happen to be provisions for your dependents’.
And he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The Pilgrim is Forgiven for, and the Paradise is Obligated for him, and the deeds are resumed for him, and there would be safety regarding his family and his wealth’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ‘Amr ibn ‘ Uthman af-Khazzaz from Afi ibn ‘ Abd Allah al-Bajaliy, from Khalid al- Qalanisiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that
Ali ibn Al-Husayn, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Perform ‘Umrah and Hajj, your bodies will become healthy, your sustenance increase and you will have sufficient for the expenses of your families.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘One who performs Hajj is forgiven, paradise is necessary, he resumes his deeds and he is safe and sound as well as his family and properties.’”
